description: Muse Patches 0.7.12 — X/Piko add-on patches. New 'Clean affiliate link button' patch: adds a 'アフィ外して開く' entry to the post ⋯ menu. Tapping it fully resolves that post's links (short/redirector hops included), strips the affiliate parts and opens the first one — the explicit full-strength counterpart to the automatic local-only cleaning.
